author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
The Windows Utility has evolved significantly in 2026. In this video, I walk through the redesigned interface, faster lazy loading, improved application installation, safer Windows tweaks, expanded logging, update controls, and the streamlined Windows 11 Creator.

I also explain which tweaks you should avoid, why hardware companion applications can create security and privacy problems, and my ongoing work investigating Windows Global Device Identifiers.

⚠️ Always copy the official command directly from my website. Fake and typo-squatted domains have previously been used to distribute malware.
